up: I need a list of molecules that are associated with the document identified by ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1140357'. For each such molecule, provide the molecule's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the compound name as listed in that document (compound_name), and the canonical SMILES representation of the molecule (canonical_smiles). Only include molecules that have a canonical SMILES available. The list should contain distinct combinations of ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by ChEMBL ID, then compound name, then canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON docs.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1140357' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
